name: Link Card
description: A title and text that go to one page. The whole card is one link: its title link covers it. On hover, and while keyboard focus is on a link inside it, the card shows its hover colors. Don't put a button in it.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): 16px corners, 24px card padding, the 8px space below the title, the 16px space below the text, the Cloud fill and Tinta text
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2273 (closes #2271): 18px body text; az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2286: its 28px line height
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5)
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): .card.bg-cloud.hover: the hover colors, and their 300ms ease-out fade
The AZ Digital UX Design System Figma file's Card component (2026-10-29): Style Cloud, with Default and Hover states

root.description: The card. It shows its hover colors on hover, and while keyboard focus is on its title link or another link inside it (focus-visible), so keyboard users see the same change.

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, draw a 1px border instead so the card keeps its edge.

transition.duration.$description: How long the card's fill and text colors take to change on hover and with keyboard focus. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the colors still change.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the card's color changes: ease-out. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

title.description: The card's heading: a link that covers the whole card. With keyboard focus, its ring is drawn in its own color, so it stands out from the fill as much as its text does.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

text.description: The card's text, below the title.

font.size.$description: Card text size: the same as body text.

line-height.$description: Card text line height: the same as body text.
